tasks.title: Rate readouts on the Temporal Matrix are off by a factor of R
tasks.why: The instrument shows rates in the wrong unit. Displayed rate values must agree with dtau/dq = J_ret/J0 and with the declared constants; a factor R has crept in between the computed rate and the rendered one.

tasks.title: Civil time leaks into tau in getMatrixNow()
tasks.why: Canon keeps civil time and Matrix time separate: civil time may drive the display, never tau itself. getMatrixNow() currently mixes them.
notes: 2026-09-13T21:40:12Z chatgpt: Removed timezone offset from getMatrixNow; elapsed UTC from fixed equinox is shared by website and clock app. Boundary and timezone tests passed.

tasks.title: CAL360.epochLive is referenced but never defined
tasks.why: A live reference with no definition. Either define it in the calendar block or remove the reference; do not paper over it with a default.
notes: 2026-09-13T21:40:12Z chatgpt: Defined CAL360.epochLive as 2027-03-20T20:25:00Z using USNO minute-resolution prediction, activated fixed shared launch, and added pre-launch calendar and process handling.
